title: Zero Trust AI (ZTAI)
subtitle: Secure the data, models and workflows of AI, from development to controlled execution and output release.
imageAlt: An AI core connected to data and services through several security boundaries and access gates
intro: Start with the zero trust principles, then follow the operational foundations, maturity stages and practical controls. Then examine indirect access through code, outputs and infrastructure administration, and how to keep autonomous agents within enforceable authority boundaries.
